data.title: About Emile
bio: Emile brings over 23 years of real estate experience across New Jersey, specializing in both residential and commercial properties.

His long-standing expertise, strong market understanding, and commitment to client success make him a trusted resource for buyers, sellers, and investors seeking reliable guidance in today’s real estate landscape.
Call him today to get started on your next big move!
